title: Windows UI parity and stale-session cleanup
highlights: Windows: Devices and Pairing tabs merged into a single Devices view that mirrors the macOS layout, with pending requests, status-aware connect buttons (Discovered / Trusted / Connected) and revoke for trusted peers all on one page.
Windows: Input Sharing rebuilt around the macOS form — four edge pickers (left, right, top, bottom) bound to the trusted device list with real persistence in AppSettings.EdgeConfig.

Windows: News & Updates tab added with the same Mac-style layout, fed by entanglo.netlify.app so every release now ships with proper changelog entries and a one-click installer that quits, updates and relaunches Entanglo for you.
